decision: The source-predicted monotone curve is numerically confirmed and severe-clean, but it does not demonstrate repeatable blind visual product value over the simpler global curve before the same fixed AO6 look.
forbidden_rescue: Do not tune the predictor, row set, round seeds, thresholds, curve strength or AO6 after unblinding.
retained_evidence: Retain monotone source prediction as a bounded explicit digital-neutral-base research mechanism, not as the preferred product auto-base.
next_leaf: Return to a distinct film-imaging algorithm or physical-image-formation leaf; the simpler global curve or unchanged AO6 remains the fallback.
allowed_claim: Three blinded autonomous target-match rounds found no confirmed severe artifact, but only one met the frozen ridge-preference gate.
forbidden_claim: Not owner or population preference, film, stock, calibration, product promotion, or evidence that explicit adaptive curves never help.
claim_ceiling: closed blind visual product-value test for one source-predicted digital neutral base before fixed AO6
